{{recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
* 6 rashers thick cut [[Cookbook:Bacon|bacon]], sliced (or 5 drops liquid smoke)
* 4 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] canned [[Cookbook:Kidney Bean|kidney beans]], rinsed and drained
* ½ cup [[Cookbook:Molasses|molasses]]
* ¼ cup blackstrap molasses, plus more as needed
* ¼ cup dark [[Cookbook:Brown Sugar|brown sugar]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] dark [[Cookbook:Rum|rum]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] salt
* ½ tsp [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|black pepper]]
* 1 tbsp dry [[Cookbook:Mustard|mustard]]

== Procedure ==
#Cook bacon. Separate the meat from the fat, and chop the bacon.
#Place 1 tbsp of the bacon fat into a large stainless steel pan. Add kidney beans and [[Cookbook:Sautéing|sauté]] over medium-high heat.
#Add rum and tilt to ignite. If you do not have a gas [[Cookbook:Stovetop|stove]], simply light with a fire stick.
#Add remaining ingredients and chopped bacon and fold to combine. 
#[[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] in a 325°F [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] for 1 ½ hours, adding blackstrap molasses occasionally to prevent drying.
